name: FactLot connect
description: How to connect FactLot to AI clients. Generated from site/_data/connect.json by scripts/site/build.mjs.

auth.free: No key. 60 requests a minute and 25 registry lookups a day per IP address.
auth.key: A Pro, Team or free key in the header Authorization: Bearer <key>.
auth.oauth: Clients that cannot send a header connect to the sign-in URL (OAuth 2.1, dynamic client registration) and paste a Pro or Team key once or continue on the free tier.

lookup_pages.json: Add format=json, or send Accept: application/json, for the hosted API's own answer (registry_search_address for a search, registry_get for a record).
lookup_pages.auth: No key. A Pro, Team or free key is honoured in the header Authorization: Bearer <key>, never in the address.
lookup_pages.counting: A search is one registry lookup and a record another, on the same allowance as the API (25 a day per IP address without a key). A search that finds nothing is not counted, and a record that has a public property page is sent to that page and is not counted.

verification_note: Steps follow each vendor's documentation as read on 2026-11-12, except where a path says otherwise. One path has been exercised from the vendor's own app, the claude.ai custom connector on 2026-11-12; no other path has been. The connectors guide in the repository lists what has been tested.

paths.name: claude.ai, Claude Desktop and mobile: custom connector
paths.you_get: All hosted tools, in chat.

auth.free: Choose Continue on the free tier on the FactLot sign-in page, or use the keyless URL below.
auth.key: Choose Connect with my key on the sign-in page and paste a Pro or Team key once (the sign-in page does not take a free key); or add a Pro, Team or free key as a request header Authorization: Bearer <key> and use the keyless URL.
auth.oauth: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; sign-in starts when the client reaches the URL without credentials.

steps: Open Customize, then Connectors, then + Add, then Add custom connector.
Name it FactLot and enter the URL. Continue, and choose Sign in now.
On the FactLot page that opens, paste a key or continue on the free tier.
Keyless alternative: enter https://api.factlot.com/mcp and choose No sign in.

verification.docs: Steps follow the vendor's documentation as read on 2026-11-12.
verification.exercised: Exercised from claude.ai on 2026-11-12 on the free tier: added by the sign-in URL, sign-in and client identity detected, the tools listed, and one registry answer returned. The paid path (a key on the consent page) was not tried.
